market_question: Will US withdraw from NATO before 2027?
reasoning: If Trump wins the 2024 election (current prediction markets give ~48% chance), he could follow through on threats to withdraw from NATO—conditional probability ~25% given his history and potential Congressional/legal obstacles, but the market rules credit any official notice even if later blocked. If a Democrat wins, withdrawal is near zero. Weighting yields p(Yes) ≈ 12%, significantly above the 7.8% market-implied price.
evidence_points: Trump repeatedly threatened to leave NATO during his first term and may be unrestrained in a second term.
The NATO Support Act of 2023 requires Senate approval or an act of Congress for withdrawal, but a determined executive might send a denunciation notice anyway.

Article 13 of the North Atlantic Treaty allows any party to cease to be a party one year after notice; any US government transmission of such a notice would qualify under the market's rules, even if implementation is judicially blocked.
sources_consulted: Historical statements by Donald Trump on NATO (2016-2020)
